risks.risk: Panel specifications (wattage, efficiency, cell type) are unknown, so the value cannot be priced reliably.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel label/sticker showing brand, model, and watt rating (W), plus serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used solar panel with unknown wattage (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: The seller’s battery claims may not match what is being sold (battery not shown).
risks.proof: Photos of the exact battery: label with capacity (Ah/Wh), voltage (e.g., 12V/24V/48V), chemistry (LiFePO4/lead-acid), date code, and terminal condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if no battery is included or battery performance is not proven (worst-case).

risks.risk: System compatibility risk (panel voltage/current vs charge controller/inverter) if this is meant as a complete setup.
risks.proof: Photos of the charge controller and inverter model labels, and the panel connector type; plus a wiring/connection photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as panel-only (not a complete working system).

risks.risk: Condition risk (scratches, micro-cracks, water ingress) cannot be assessed from one wide shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the panel surface (corners and cell lines) and the backsheet/edges; ideally a power-on test reading (IV curve or multimeter voltage under sun).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially used/with unknown condition (worst-case).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the solar panel label/sticker (brand, model, watt rating W, serial number).
Photos of the battery being sold (label with capacity/voltage/chemistry and date code) and terminals.
A screenshot/photo of a battery runtime test showing load and measured runtime (to support the “8 hours” claim).
Photos of charge controller and inverter labels (if included) and a wiring/connection photo.
